lines.text: Would you take one million dollars right now, or one penny that doubles every day for thirty days?
Day seven: sixty-four cents. Not even a dollar.
Day fourteen: eighty-two dollars. The million is looking smart.
Day twenty-seven: six hundred seventy-one thousand. Still behind.
Day twenty-eight: one point three four million. You just passed it.
Day twenty-nine: two point six eight million.
five point three seven million dollars.
Half of it came on the very last day. That's the power of doubling. What should we double next?
